ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 35-40% high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal lobes versus 60-65% low-intensity black pixels concentrated centrally.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions on distal lobes; transition zone to central black area characterized by dense stippling and distinctive vertical linear streaks (drips) extending from the trailing edge into the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 115-120 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire span; a prominent, irregular macro-notch is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex leading edges tapering to acute points; trailing edges exhibit a slight concavity toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-relief, brownish-yellow pixel groupings (barnacle colonization) concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several fine, low-contrast grey linear streaks (scratches) visible on the dark central pigmentation, primarily oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular U-shaped notch or trauma-induced lesion on the trailing edge of the right lobe; dense barnacle clusters on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive vertical black striations breaking the white distal patches, creating a high-contrast 'ink-drip' visual pattern.
